properties.name: icon
properties.description: Material Symbols Outlined icon name (shorthand). Ignored when the `icon` slot is filled.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible text label. Recommended for all destinations (MD3 a11y).

properties.name: active
properties.description: Active / selected state. Reflected. Managed by `<md-navigation-rail>`.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disabled — destination cannot be activated and is removed from tab order.

properties.name: badge
properties.description: Show a small dot badge (notification indicator).

properties.name: badgeValue
properties.description: Numeric / textual badge value (renders large badge).

properties.name: href
properties.description:
When set, the tab is rendered as a link (anchor) with the given href.
Activates link semantics (uses `aria-current="page"` when active).

properties.name: target
properties.description: Optional target for the link (when `href` is set).

properties.name: labelVisibility
properties.description:
Controls label visibility. Usually set automatically by the parent
`<md-navigation-rail>` based on its `label-visibility` prop.

properties.name: expanded
properties.description: True when the parent rail is expanded; managed by the parent.

properties.name: density
properties.description:
Local density rung. Drives the same `--md-sys-density-scale` signal that a
global `data-density` ancestor sets, so a local value simply overrides the
inherited one. 0 = default, -4 = ultra-compact.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Replace prop-based icon with custom SVG/font/component

cssParts.name: icon-wrapper
cssParts.description: Wrapper holding the icon and badge

cssParts.name: anchor
cssParts.description: The internal <a> element when `href` is set

attributes.name: class
attributes.value:
{
          'md-navigation-rail-tab': true,
          'md-navigation-rail-tab--active': this.active,
          'md-navigation-rail-tab--child-selected': this.submenuHasSelection && !this.active,
          'md-navigation-rail-tab--disabled': this.disabled,
          'md-navigation-rail-tab--has-label': !!this.label,
          [`md-navigation-rail-tab--labels-${this.labelVisibility}`]: true,
          'md-navigation-rail-tab--expanded': this.expanded,
        }

name: Navigation Rail Tab
description: One destination in a md-navigation-rail. Icon, label, active indicator, optional badge, a stable value for routing, and an optional dropdown.

notes: Native Material/Compose appearance; CSS selectors, DOM APIs, browser form APIs, cancelable DOM events and source imperative methods are not compiled. Unsupported source properties are reported by the compiler.
